args.code:
from sympy import isprime, primerange

# Search for p such that p, 800-p, and 800+p are all prime.
# We assume p is an odd prime, so p >= 3.
# Since q > p and q < 800, we test p up to 397 (largest prime < 400).
primes_p = list(primerange(3, 400))
valid_p = []

for p in primes_p:
    if isprime(800 - p) and isprime(800 + p):
        valid_p.append(p)

print(f"Valid primes p: {valid_p}")

def is_prime(n):
    if n < 2:
        return False
    i = 2
    while i * i <= n:
        if n % i == 0:
            return False
        i += 1
    return True

p = 13
q = 787
r = 797

# Constraints check
print(f"p={p} is prime: {is_prime(p)}")
print(f"q={q} is prime: {is_prime(q)}")
print(f"r={r} is prime: {is_prime(r)}")

# P1 = p+q-r
P1 = p + q - r
print(f"P1 = {P1} is prime: {is_prime(P1)}")

# P2 = q+r-p
P2 = q + r - p
print(f"P2 = {P2} is prime: {is_prime(P2)}")

# P3 = r+p-q
P3 = r + p - q
print(f"P3 = {P3} is prime: {is_prime(P3)}")

# P4 = p+q+r
P4 = p + q + r
print(f"P4 = {P4} is prime: {is_prime(P4)}")
